system.longDesc:
A broadsword is a wide, straight, double-edged sword that can be held in one hand. A cutlass is curved and single edged. Many weapons are equivalent to these, from single-edged backswords to the double-edged Walloon sword. These weapons are thicker than other military sabers. Those with well-developed basket hilts (add +1 to the Resources cost) give their users +1 to Defense against hand-to-hand attacks, though they do nothing to protect against ranged threats.

Focus: Heavy Blades. Minimum Strength 1. Resources TN 11.
